context: Classic participation-inequality: ~1% of an online community actively create content, 9% contribute occasionally, 90% lurk (Nielsen / NN-g).
Newer research finds the creating share has risen to as much as ~23% on some social platforms vs the classic 1%.
Over 70% of all app users abandon an app within three months of install.
Fitness apps average ~8-12% retention at 30 days (midpoint ~10%).
Average 90-day retention for fitness apps is ~31%.
Average annual retention for fitness apps is ~19%.
Strava's 30-day retention is ~16% on iOS, 8% on Android.
Strava's gamified Challenges feature lifted 90-day retention from 18% to 32% - the closest analog to Journeys' completion summaries and follow-along hooks.
